# Haze UI — Full API Reference

> Complete props reference for all 116 Haze UI components in one
> file (207 type tables), generated from the library source. Do not
> edit by hand — regenerate with `node scripts/generate-llms-full.mjs`. For the
> curated index with overviews, design tokens and architecture notes, see
> [llms.txt](llms.txt).

## Install

Peer range `react: ^19.0.0` — no React 18 compatibility layer.

```sh
npm i haze-ui
# optional peers, only for the components that need them:
npm i react-f0rm                            # FormItem
npm i @tanstack/react-table                 # DataTable
npm i recharts                              # Chart
npm i @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable \
      @dnd-kit/utilities                    # TagInput/TagGroup sortable
```

## CSS: two loading modes

The JS entry imports no stylesheet — pick one mode:

```jsx
// 1) Full stylesheet (simplest)
import 'haze-ui/styles.css';

// 2) Per-component CSS: tokens once + each component you use
import 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css';
import 'haze-ui/css/button.css';
```

Per-component files are kebab-case names, but sub-components and cores share their
directory's family file (`InputCore` → `input.css`). Don't hardcode the mapping:
`haze-ui/css-manifest.json` is the machine-readable, build-generated export → css-file
map (with family absorption and a `noCss` list) — tooling should read it instead of
re-deriving file names.

## Components

One section per component: its `haze-ui` import, then a props table per exported
type. Type strings are verbatim from the TypeScript source; handwritten rows the
extractor cannot see (`className`, `...rest`, `children`) close each table.

## Accordion

```jsx
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from 'haze-ui';
```

### AccordionItemProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Header text shown in the summary |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Collapsible content |

### AccordionProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `exclusive` | `boolean` | `false` | Only one item open at a time (uses name attribute) |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | AccordionItem elements |

### AlertProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `visible` | `ControlOrValue<boolean>` | `true` | Visibility state (controllable) |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Called when the close button is clicked |
| `variant` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'info'` | Color variant |
| `closable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a close button |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Alert content |

## Anchor

```jsx
import { Anchor } from 'haze-ui';
```

### AnchorProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `AnchorItem[]` | — | Anchor sections in document order; each id must match an element rendered on the page |
| `activeId` | `ControlOrValue<string>` | `first item's id` | Highlighted section id — accepts a control (controlled) or a plain value (uncontrolled initial). Scroll-spy and clicks write through it |
| `onClick` | `(id: string) => void` | — | Fires when a link is clicked (the highlight moves and scrolling is queued first) |
| `offsetTop` | `number` | `0` | Gap kept between the container top and the section top when scrolling (sticky header height), px |
| `bounds` | `number` | `5` | Scroll-spy trigger line, px from the container top (engines without IntersectionObserver) |
| `getContainer` | `() => HTMLElement \| Window` | `() => window` | Scroll container the anchors navigate and observe |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |

| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |

## Tree

```jsx
import { Tree } from 'haze-ui';
```

### TreeProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `treeData` | `TreeNodeData[]` | — | Array of tree node data |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow multiple selection |
| `checkable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show checkbox before each node |
| `checkStrictly` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable parent-child cascade selection |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `true` | Allow node selection |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the entire tree |
| `blockNode` | `boolean` | `false` | Node content takes full width |
| `showLine` | `boolean` | `false` | Show connecting lines between nodes |
| `showIcon` | `boolean` | `false` | Show icon for each node |
| `switcherIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom expand/collapse icon |
| `loadingIcon` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `titleRender` | `(node: TreeNodeData) => ReactNode` | — | Custom title renderer |
| `iconRender` | `(node: TreeNodeData) => ReactNode` | — | Custom icon renderer |
| `virtualized` | `boolean \| TreeVirtualizedConfig` | — |  |
| `loadData` | `(node: TreeNodeData) => Promise<TreeNodeData[]>` | — |  |
| `searchValue` | `string` | — |  |
| `expandedKeys` | `ControlOrValue<string[]>` | — | Controlled expanded node keys |
| `selectedKeys` | `ControlOrValue<string[]>` | — | Controlled selected node keys |
| `checkedKeys` | `ControlOrValue<string[]>` | — | Controlled checked node keys |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |
| `onExpand` | `(expandedKeys: string[], info: { expanded: boolean; node: TreeNodeData; }) => void` | — | Callback when node is expanded/collapsed |
| `onSelect` | `(selectedKeys: string[], info: { selected: boolean; selectedNodes: TreeNodeData[]; node: TreeNodeData; }) => void` | — | Callback when node is selected |
| `onCheck` | `(checkedKeys: string[] \| { checked: string[]; halfChecked: string[]; }, info: { checked: boolean; checkedNodes: TreeNodeData[]; node: TreeNodeData; halfCheckedKeys: string[]; }) => void` | — | Callback when node is checked |

### TreeNodeData

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | — | Unique identifier for the node |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | Display title of the node |
| `children` | `TreeNodeData[]` | — | Child nodes |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the node |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `true` | Allow node selection |
| `disableCheckbox` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the checkbox for this node |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom icon for this node |
| `isLeaf` | `boolean` | — | Mark as leaf node (for lazy loading) |

### TreeState

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expandedKeys` | `string[]` | — |  |
| `selectedKeys` | `string[]` | — |  |
| `checkedKeys` | `string[]` | — |  |
| `halfCheckedKeys` | `string[]` | — |  |

| `action` | `string` | — |  |
| `method` | `string` | — |  |
| `headers` | `Record<string, string>` | — |  |
| `name` | `string` | — |  |
| `data` | `Record<string, string \| Blob>` | — |  |
| `manual` | `boolean` | — |  |
| `showUploadList` | `boolean \| { itemRender?: UploadListItemRender \| undefined; }` | — |  |
| `listType` | `'text' \| 'picture-card'` | — |  |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | — |  |
| `directory` | `boolean` | — |  |
| `onStatusChange` | `(files: UploadFileStatus[]) => void` | — |  |
| `onChange` | `(files: File[]) => void` | — | Called when files are selected |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |

## VirtualList

```jsx
import { VirtualList } from 'haze-ui';
```

### VirtualListProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `T[]` | — | Array of items to render |
| `height` | `number` | — | Container height in px |
| `itemHeight` | `number` | — | Height of each item in px |
| `estimatedItemHeight` | `number` | — |  |
| `groups` | `VirtualListGroup[]` | — |  |
| `renderItem` | `(item: T, index: number) => ReactNode` | — | Item renderer |
| `overscan` | `number` | `5` | Extra items to render outside viewport |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | — |  |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |
| `ref` | `Ref<VirtualListHandle>` | — |  |

## Watermark

```jsx
import { Watermark } from 'haze-ui';
```

### WatermarkProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string \| string[]` | — | Watermark text; an array renders stacked lines |
| `font` | `WatermarkFont` | `{ size: 14, color: theme text-muted, weight: 400 }` | Typography of the drawn text: size (px), color, weight, family |
| `rotate` | `number` | `-22` | Tile rotation in degrees |
| `gap` | `number \| [number, number]` | `100` | Space between tiles, px — one number or [x, y] |
| `offset` | `[number, number]` | `[0, 0]` | Offset of the tile grid origin, px |
| `zIndex` | `number` | `9` | Overlay stacking order |
| `fullscreen` | `boolean` | `false` | Cover the whole viewport (fixed layer) instead of the container |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Content to watermark; with children the component acts as their container |
| `className` | `string` | — | Additional CSS class |
